# GitHub workflow guide

The workflow in `workflows/python-app.yml` is a smoke/demo guard, not Branch 60
admission evidence. Pytest is currently disabled there. A green workflow does
not prove indexed-pretraining resume, exact sample-order equivalence,
complete-store replay, MLflow custody, or full-corpus training.

Branch 60 admission evidence belongs in the explicit data courts, local
checkpoint readback, exact run contract, and external MLflow/artifact records.
Do not add a second pretraining implementation to CI to compensate for a
missing court; invoke the canonical source and make unavailable checks visible.
